g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Amount' for a linear scale with values from 0 to 3,000
Y-axis titled 'Category' for a discrete scale with 12 values: Housing, Groceries, Dining, Transport, Utilities, ending with Uncategorized
Symbol legend titled 'Series' for fill color with 2 values: Spent, Budget
Title text 'Spending and budget by category'
